name: popover
title: Popover
description: A floating panel of content or controls anchored to a button.
a11y: The trigger has aria-expanded and aria-controls; the panel is role=dialog.
Focus moves into the panel; Escape or an outside click closes it and focus returns to the trigger.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled. Default false.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the next open state when the user opens or dismisses it.

props.name: children
props.description: The parts of the component: a trigger and its content.

props.name: onEscapeKeyDown
props.description: Called when Escape is pressed; call `event.preventDefault()` to keep it open.

props.name: onInteractOutside
props.description: Called when a press or focus lands outside; call `event.preventDefault()` to keep it open.

props.name: onOpenAutoFocus
props.description: Called after it opens, before focus moves in; `preventDefault()` keeps focus where it is or lets you move it yourself.

props.name: onCloseAutoFocus
props.description: Called after it closes, before focus returns to the trigger; `preventDefault()` lets you move focus yourself.

import {Button, Popover, PopoverContent, PopoverTrigger} from '@monoline/react';
